notes.title: Pricing decision August
notes.body:
# Pricing decision

We chose the monthly plan at 25 dollars a month.
Reason: customers want to start small and cancel at any time.
Sam agreed, Priya wanted to test a yearly plan later.

notes.title: Pricing decision September
notes.body:
# Pricing decision

We moved to the yearly plan at 40 dollars, billed once.
Sam argued the monthly plan churned too fast after the second month.
This replaces the August decision.
